plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 Major Map (recommended sequence) for the B.S. in Sport & Entertainment Management, Sport Management Concentration, College of Hospitality, Retail, and Sport Management, Dept. of Sport and Entertainment Management, from the USC Major Map Repository (2026_spte-spte-mgmt_map.pdf). 8 semesters plus a required 6-credit summer internship (SPTE 295) after sophomore year, transcribed as its own term. Semester sums verified against printed totals (15/16/16/15/6/12/15/15/6 at slot minimums = 116 total; official degree minimum 120 per Graduation Requirements Summary: 120 total, 42 major, 35-47 college/program, 31-43 Carolina Core; range slots/electives fill to 120+). Ranged slots transcribed at minimums with notes: Carolina Core Req (3-4) at 3; Foreign Language/other CC (3-4) at 3; CC Req or Elective 'if needed' (0-3) at 0, marked required_zero per the BACKLOG-18 variable-credit convention; SPTE 195 (0 cr, S grade) marked required_zero. NOTE: minimum institutional GPA is 2.75 (higher than the usual 2.00); critical courses require 2.75 GPA to enroll in Professional Division courses; foreign language proficiency (placement 2+, or 109+110, or 121) required. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
